turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and Owen found out about this on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to him first?
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
That's not what I asked. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Then you'll have no trouble answering me. Who decided on the zero?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
You're leading me, and I've done this for twenty years. My child doesn't lie, and I'm not agreeing to anything that starts from "cheat". What do you have, other than a checker?
